objective: Build, verify, benchmark, document, and package Suture v0.1 in Rust as an AI-first deterministic file-mutation protocol and runtime that identifies exact targets, guards pre-state, applies only authorised mutations, preserves protected state, refuses ambiguity informatively, and returns compact verification certificates without requiring full-file rereads.
definition_of_done:
Strict structured JSON/schema request-response tool protocol implemented for Raw Text, Strict JSON, and TOML providers.
Deterministic identity-guarding and cardinality enforcement (default 1) rejecting ambiguity, stale snapshots, and duplicate targets without first-match guessing.
Unrelated byte and structured state preservation verified with explicit guarantees; lossy operations strictly opt-in.
Informative structured refusal diagnostics emitted for cardinality mismatch, near-miss invisible characters, malformed structure, and stale hashes.
Suture Core solely owns safe/atomic commits within workspace boundaries; providers parse and plan but never write to disk.
Pre-commit verification and post-commit compact evidence certificates (with minimal diffs and hashes) generated so agents do not reread full files.
Dry-run execution uses identical planning and verification pipelines without mutating files.
Native single-binary distributions built and verified for Windows x86_64 and Linux x86_64 (including WSL) with working 'suture doctor'.
Adversarial corpus (38+ cases) executed and comparative benchmark report published measuring 'wrong mutation reported as successful' and token reread reduction.
All test suites (cargo test, cargo clippy, cargo fmt) pass cleanly with #![forbid(unsafe_code)] in Suture-owned code.
Full documentation suite complete: README, architecture, protocol schema, threat model, provider contract, and benchmark report.

hard_constraints.text: Never guess a destructive target: If exactly one target is expected and reality yields zero or multiple matches, Suture must fail-closed and refuse without choosing a candidate silently.
Every mutation must be identity-guarded against stale context and target substitution before execution.
Providers must never open file paths or commit bytes directly; only Suture Core validates MutationPlans and performs writes.
No silent weakening: structural requests must never fall back to raw text, regex, or unverified writes upon parse failure.
Unauthorised state is protected: byte regions outside authorised edits must remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
Pre-commit verification is mandatory before reporting APPLIED; all successful mutations must return compact deterministic evidence certificates.
Workspace confinement is mandatory: path traversal, symlink escape, or TOCTOU exploits beyond the declared workspace root must be refused.
Malformed structured input must refuse with precise diagnostics; no automatic or silent syntax repairs permitted.
Outcome semantics are strictly typed to exactly four values: APPLIED, NO_CHANGE, REFUSED, FAILED.
Use #![forbid(unsafe_code)] across all Suture-owned Rust code unless strictly justified, isolated, and documented.

architecture_decisions.text: Single-source-of-truth Rust schema types: Derive serde serialization, schemars JSON schema, and CLI tool interfaces from Rust types to prevent schema drift.
Single-crate repository structure for v0.1 under src/ (protocol, engine, document, workspace, path, certificate, diff, provider/).
Type-state mutation pipeline: ObservedDocument -> IdentifiedTarget -> PreparedPlan -> VerifiedPlan -> CommittedMutation; unverified plans cannot invoke commit.
Format-native concrete syntax representation for providers (CST/lossless parser) rather than generic AST/JSON trees to preserve comments, formatting, and quote styles.
Content-and-context addressed stable anchors rather than position-only line or byte offset anchors.
Explicit PathNamespace model (Native, Windows, WSL, Posix) to handle path cross-translation and symlinks without relying on host shell escaping.
Unified dry-run execution reusing identical plan preparation, candidate generation, and validation pipelines, omitting only the commit phase.

technology_choices.text: Full-strength idiomatic Rust (edition 2021/current stable) as sole runtime language.
Core crates: serde, serde_json, schemars, thiserror, sha2, similar, cap-std (or capability-safe fs abstraction).
Provider parsers: jsonc-parser (strict CST configuration) for JSON; toml_edit for TOML.
Native single-binary distribution via cargo-dist / release CI generating standalone executables and SHA256 checksums.

forbidden_changes.text: No general regex mutation engine in v0.1.
No AST/Tree-sitter/LSP code parsers, semantic symbol renaming, or workspace-wide find-references.
No YAML, HTML, XML, or Markdown structural providers in v0.1.
No scripting languages, loops, conditionals, workflow engines, variables, or dynamic plugin loaders.
No network calls, Git operations, background daemons, telemetry, or external service integrations.
No mandatory custom textual DSL syntax (.sut) for tool invocation; protocol must be strict JSON schema.

functional_requirements.text: Raw Text Provider: Support identify, replace, insert_before, insert_after, delete, and optional move on exact content/context targets.
Strict JSON Provider: Parse strict JSON, identify path targets, support set, insert mapping/array items, delete, and key rename while preserving formatting and validating final JSON.
TOML Provider: Parse TOML via toml_edit, support path selection, set, insert, delete, and key rename while preserving comments, spacing, and ordering.

Cardinality & Diagnostics: Enforce expected cardinality (default 1). Emit candidate anchors/context hashes for multiple matches and byte-diff diagnostics for near misses (invisible characters, whitespace, newlines, BOM).
Encoding & Newline Handling: Support UTF-8, UTF-8 with BOM, LF, CRLF, and preserve existing trailing newline state.
Idempotence & Replay: Re-applying an already satisfied desired state returns NO_CHANGE; stale pre-state returns REFUSED:STALE_IDENTITY.
Confinement & Commit: Execute pre-commit validation and atomic single-file commit strictly within workspace root, preventing symlink escapes and TOCTOU vulnerabilities.
Evidence Certificate: Return compact machine-readable certificate containing status, minimal bounded diff, pre/post hashes, cardinality, and preservation facts.
CLI Interface: Provide CLI commands ('suture apply', 'suture dry-run', 'suture schema', 'suture doctor', '--version') reading JSON requests from stdin or file.

non_functional_requirements.text: Performance: File mutations on standard files must execute with near-zero latency without background daemons.
Zero-Dependency Distribution: Single statically linkable binary for Windows and Linux/WSL requiring no runtime, Cargo, or external dependencies.
Privacy: Never echo full files or unrelated file contents into certificates; bound diff context to prevent credential leakage.
Typed Error Taxonomy: Stable machine-readable refusal and failure error codes with structured payload details.

acceptance_criteria.text: cargo test, cargo fmt --check, and strict cargo clippy pass with zero warnings and no unexplained unsafe code on Windows and Linux targets.
Text provider tests pass for single replace, duplicate refusal, near-miss invisible character diagnostics, insert, delete, and CRLF/LF/BOM preservation.
JSON and TOML provider tests verify structured set/insert/delete, comment/whitespace preservation, malformed rejection, and final validation.
Workspace traversal and symlink escape fixtures are refused without modifying target files.
Certificates emit bounded minimal diffs and verified pre/post hashes; dry-run produces matching output without persisting changes.

38+ adversarial corpus cases run; benchmark report published comparing Suture against baselines on 'wrong mutation reported as successful' and token reread metrics; README, architecture, protocol, threat model, and provider contract docs complete.

important_context.text: Verification-by-rereading is a major token and reasoning cost for coding agents; Suture functions as a context-compression and safety boundary.

AI research consensus across Gemini, DeepSeek, and Claude emphasized strict JSON tool schemas, content-addressed anchors, fail-closed diagnostics, and CST-preserving providers over AST/LSP expansions.
Suture cooperates with existing tools: it is not a search engine (rg), VCS (git), formatter (rustfmt/prettier), or test runner.

important_rationale.text: Rust was selected over Go and OCaml to enforce memory safety, impossible-state modeling via type-state, and single-binary native portability without runtime baggage.
Explicit hard-fact preservation claims (e.g. comments_removed: 0) replace subjective formatting drift scores to ensure auditable deterministic guarantees.
'Wrong mutation reported as successful' is the primary benchmark metric because silent edit corruption is the most damaging agent failure mode.

known_dependencies.text: serde and serde_json for JSON protocol deserialization and schema generation.
schemars for automatic derived JSON schema emission.
toml_edit for concrete-syntax lossless TOML manipulation.
jsonc-parser (or equivalent strict CST parser) for non-destructive JSON editing.
similar for minimal bounded unified diff computation.
cap-std / atomic file replacement utility for capability-confinement and TOCTOU safety.

known_risks.text: TOCTOU race conditions during file replace if handle verification is uncoupled from atomic commit.
WSL vs Windows filesystem path translation inconsistencies (e.g. non-standard mount paths or case-sensitivity mismatch).
Third-party parser limitations in preserving unusual comments, whitespace, or key ordering in JSON/TOML documents.

open_questions.text: Whether the core 'move' operation will be fully implemented in v0.1 or deferred if it introduces disproportionate initial complexity after replace/insert/delete.
Whether UTF-16LE/BE with BOM support will be cleanly included in v0.1 or deferred to future releases.

active_decisions.text: Tool interface will be strict JSON tool-calls via stdin/file CLI flags; no custom textual DSL.
Implementation will reside in a single primary crate rather than a premature Cargo workspace.
Architectural boundary strictly separates format providers (parse/plan/validate) from Suture Core (commit/write).
